_packageDtsBytesWhy: Raised from 409 600 to 524 288 B (512 KB) by design/12 §3 S, the session layer. Measured 377 261 B before and 504 595 B after: design/07 §4.2 s ~50 error classes (errors/classes.d.ts 13.4 KB), §1.3 s four handle interfaces inside query/types.d.ts (+7.6 KB), and the declaration files for src/session, src/observe and src/pooler. This is a SIZE gate and not a type-performance one — the headline instantiation counts did not move (ts5.9 80 485 unchanged, ts7 131 388 -> 131 354, i.e. noise), which is the prediction design/12 §3 S made: session types are not on the query hot path. tools/budgets.json gates the same bytes at 900 KB against design/08 §1.2 and passes; this number is the tighter of the two and still ratchets.

_design04Measured._why: design/04 §3.5's own 'Measured today' column, for an honest three-way print: design-04 / here / budget. design/04's prototype was a declaration-only `src/core.ts`; this harness measures the real implementation.

_measuredWs0._why: design/09 §3.0, `node bench/types/forks.mjs`, measured on the WS0 declaration-only prototype: marginal instantiations per distinct query, identical at 25/100/300 tables and on both compilers. Kept as the WS0 baseline so WS1's additions — left-join nullability, the GROUP BY guard, CTE handles, set ops, `$if` — read as a delta rather than as an absolute. WS1's own numbers are gated above and re-measured by `run.mjs` on every run; see design/09 §3.1.
